title: MCP tool calls are recorded in the AI audit log, admin AI endpoints are audited, and REST AI entries carry the cube or model

criteria.given: an authenticated caller invokes MCP tools/call (run_query, drillthrough, search_members, ...) — allowed, denied or failed
criteria.then: McpResource writes exactly one ai-audit.jsonl entry carrying the user, the tool name, the target cube or model, the policy decision and the outcome — including AiPolicyViolation denials, which the MCP envelope returns as 200 tool errors the /ai/ filter cannot see
AiAuditFilter writes an entry for it (the audited surface is no longer only paths containing /ai/), while GET /saiku/admin/ai-audit stays self-audit-exempt

criteria.given: a REST AI call whose request names a cube or model (POST /ai/query, /ai/query/preview, /ai/query/execute-async, /ai/query/saved, GET /ai/schema/{cubeId}, /ai/members/search, POST /ai/ossie/query and friends)
criteria.then: the resource publishes the P_CUBE / P_MODEL enrichment the filter folds into the entry — the entry carries the cube or model, not blank
a unit test asserts the audit entry for an MCP tools/call (user, tool, target, decision, outcome, deny path), and the filter gate tests cover the widened audited surface
